description.value: Skydive Extreme Yeti is a tandem skydiving drop zone operating at Golden Municipal Airport in the heart of the Canadian Rockies, offering jumps from up to 13,000 feet AGL — one of the highest tandem skydives in Western Canada. The dropzone sits at the confluence of the Kicking Horse and Columbia Rivers, surrounded by six national parks including Yoho and Glacier. In operation since 2011, it draws adventure travelers from Banff, Lake Louise, and beyond, making it a notable landmark stop for cyclists touring the Trans-Canada corridor.
